g.text: Phase 1 — Find (parallel, no angle suppresses another)

div.p: A finding with no concrete scenario is a guess. For a cleanup, the scenario is the cost — what is duplicated, wasted, or harder to maintain.
No Agent tool? Work every angle inline, and say so in the report.
CONFIRMED — names the inputs and the wrong result
PLAUSIBLE — the default; realistic runtime state is not grounds to refute
REFUTED — only on evidence built from the code

text.tspan: fresh reviewer holding the verified list
looks only for what is missing
the traps of this language and framework
what invariant did the deleted lines hold?
existing helper, derivable state, dead code
wasted work, hot paths, captured scope
special case on shared infra = too shallow
instruction files + the line breaking it
